videos.title: #113 | Never Quit On Your Goals (Leon Jala)

videos.title: #112 | Just Do It (Leon Jala)
videos.summary: Stepping into a high-stakes leadership role doesn't require having all the answers—it demands the humility to listen, embrace imperfection, and stay anchored to a clear purpose. Discover essential lessons on overcoming imposter syndrome, leading from the ground up, and navigating the rush toward AI readiness without losing your core mission. If you want actionable wisdom on managing major career transitions with confidence and clarity, this episode is a must-watch.
